title: Entry Standards for the Office Pantry & Beverage Program Tiers
content:
The Office Pantry & Beverage Program is written at one of six tiers, and each tier carries an entry standard stated on four measures of the client site — badged headcount, plumbed water, storage space and annual pantry spend — alongside the headcount span the tier is built to serve from a single pantry.

## Entry standard and headcount span, tier by tier

| Tier | Smallest badged headcount the tier is written for | Largest badged headcount served from one pantry | Plumbed water at the site | Storage space at the site | Annual pantry spend the tier is written against (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 15 | 60 | not required | not required | 3200.00 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 40 | 150 | not required | required | 11500.00 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 120 | 350 | required | required | 34000.00 |
| Barista Bar Program | 200 | 500 | required | required | 78000.00 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 400 | 900 | required | required | 145000.00 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 1200 | 4000 | required | required | 320000.00 |

## The measures as this schedule states them

1. The smallest badged headcount is the headcount the tier is written for; the largest is the badged headcount the tier serves from one pantry. Both are whole numbers of badged employees.
2. Plumbed water is filtered water plumbed into the pantry point. Storage space is dry and chilled holding space at the site. Each is recorded against the tier as required or not required.
3. The annual pantry spend is the yearly figure in United States dollars the tier is written against.

## Reading the spans

The spans printed above overlap between neighbouring tiers. A site reporting 130 badged employees stands inside the span of Standard Snack Pantry, whose largest headcount served from one pantry is 150, and also inside the span of Fresh Pantry Program, which is written from 120 upwards. At the other edge, a site reporting 60 badged employees stands at the largest headcount Coffee & Tea Service serves from one pantry, while a site reporting 61 stands above it.
